set.body: Expanded R parity fixtures exposed a multi-condition, multi-basis ordering drift: R fmridesign currently emits multi-basis design values condition-major while its column names are basis-major; scalafim stores values basis-major under basis-major names. Decide whether to intentionally preserve scalafim's coherent ordering, mimic R exactly for compatibility, or add an explicit compatibility/export reorder. Acceptance: documented decision plus a fixture or test covering a two-condition SPMG3/trialwise basis case.
set.title: Design: resolve multi-condition multi-basis column ordering parity
